title: IELTS Speaking Mock
part1: What do you do at the moment: work, study, or both?
What do you like most about your current work or study?
How often do you use public transport?
What kind of place do you prefer for studying or working?
Do you enjoy learning new skills? Why?
What is one thing you would like to improve about your daily routine?

cards.title: Describe a skill you learned recently
bullets: why you decided to learn it
and explain how useful it has been

cards.title: Describe a place in your city that you enjoy visiting
bullets: and explain why you enjoy visiting it

cards.title: Describe a person who gave you useful advice
bullets: and explain why it was useful

cards.title: Describe a time you solved a difficult problem
bullets: and explain how you felt afterwards

cards.title: Describe a book or article you found interesting
bullets: and explain what made it interesting

cards.title: Describe a useful piece of technology you own
bullets: how long you have had it
and explain why it is useful

cards.title: Describe a memorable journey
bullets: and explain why you remember it

cards.title: Describe an event you helped organise
bullets: and explain what you learned from the experience

cards.title: Describe a meal you enjoyed with other people
bullets: and explain why the meal was memorable

cards.title: Describe a goal you want to achieve
bullets: and explain how you will feel if you achieve it

cards.title: Describe a teacher you remember well
bullets: what their teaching style was like
and explain why you remember them

cards.title: Describe an outdoor activity you would like to try
bullets: who you would like to do it with
and explain why you want to try it

part3: Why do some people find it easier than others to learn new skills?
Should schools teach more practical life skills?
How has technology changed the way people learn?
Do people rely too much on online advice?
Why are public spaces important in cities?
How can cities encourage people to use more sustainable transport?
Do employers value practical skills more than academic knowledge?
How might education change in the next twenty years?
